wl.access.readOnly: Your role does not allow changes to access settings; ask the owner.
wl.access.password.title: Viewing password
wl.access.password.description: Require a password to open this endpoint in the interface and the API. Senders are not affected: the capture URL stays open.
wl.access.password.isSet: A password is set. It cannot be shown again.
wl.access.password.isNotSet: No password is set. Anyone with the endpoint address can read its captures.
wl.access.password.willRemove: The password will be removed when you save.
wl.access.allowList.title: Senders
wl.access.allowList.enable: Accept captures only from these addresses
wl.access.allowList.description: Other senders get 403 and nothing is stored.
wl.access.allowList.label: Allowed addresses and ranges
wl.access.allowList.hint: IPv4 or IPv6 address or range, for example 203.0.113.0/24. Press Enter to add. Up to {{max}} entries.
wl.access.allowList.outside: Your address {{address}} is outside the list.
wl.access.allowList.error.format: Enter an IPv4 or IPv6 address or a range such as 203.0.113.0/24.
wl.access.allowList.error.prefix: The prefix length is out of range for this address.
wl.access.allowList.error.hostBits: This range has bits set after the prefix. Did you mean {{suggestion}}?
wl.access.captureAuth.title: Capture authentication
wl.access.captureAuth.description: Senders must present this credential, or the capture is refused with 401 and not stored.
wl.access.captureAuth.currentBasic: Basic authentication is required for the user {{name}}.
wl.access.captureAuth.kind.label: Authentication method
wl.access.captureAuth.once: This secret is shown only once. Copy it now: after you save it cannot be shown again.
wl.access.captureAuth.neverShown: Saved secrets are never shown. Changing the name or the method needs the secret again.
wl.access.issue.passwordMismatch: The two entries do not match.
wl.access.issue.cidrsEmpty: Add at least one address or range, or turn the list off.
wl.access.issue.authNameInvalid: Use up to {{max}} visible ASCII characters. A user name cannot contain a colon and a header name must be a valid token.
wl.access.issue.authSecretRequired: Enter the secret, or generate one.
wl.access.issue.notAllowed: A viewing password is only available for endpoints without an owner.
wl.access.issue.unknownOutcome: The connection failed, so it is not known whether the changes were saved. Reload the section to check before you try again.
wl.access.members.title: Members
wl.access.members.roles: Editors change settings and rules and delete captures. Viewers only read.
wl.access.members.ownerOnly: Only the owner can see and change the other members.
wl.access.members.changeRole.title: Change role
wl.access.members.changeRole.body: Make {{name}} a member with the role {{role}}? The change applies at once.
wl.access.members.removeConfirm.title: Remove member
wl.access.members.removeConfirm.body: {{name}} will lose access to this endpoint.
wl.access.members.error.load: The members could not be loaded.
wl.access.members.error.forbidden: Your role does not allow this; ask the owner.
wl.access.members.error.failed: The change could not be saved. Try again.
wl.access.members.invite.title: Invite a member
wl.access.members.invite.description: Add a person who has signed in before by their email address.
wl.access.members.invite.error.unknown: Nobody with this email has signed in yet. Ask them to sign in once, then add them.
wl.access.members.invite.error.owner: This person already owns the endpoint.
wl.access.members.invite.error.limited: Too many requests. Try again in {{seconds}} s.
wl.access.members.invite.error.failed: The member could not be added. Try again.
wl.access.locked.title: This endpoint is locked
wl.access.locked.body: Enter the password to open it. The unlock lasts for this browser session.
wl.access.locked.wrong: That password did not work. Check it and try again.
wl.access.locked.failed: The password could not be checked. Try again.
wl.access.locked.limited: Too many attempts. Wait before trying again.
wl.access.locked.retryIn: You can try again in {{seconds}} s.
